question: There is a rectangular garden of 240 metres × 80 metres. A path of width 4 metres is build outside the garden along its four sides. What is the area of the path?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea390ac5691be6cf5639ac1fe185cecdcd437ff2628e12c8758e4291ec6411f1.png] The garden EFGH is shown in the figure. Where EF = 240 meters & EH = 80 meters. The width of the path is 4 meters. Now the area of the path leaving the four colored corners = [2 × (240 × 4)] + [2 × (80 × 4)]
